APPROVE
`Nest` drops to a cognitive complexity of about 3, and the extracted helpers keep the original logic. `NestDecision` gives the same result as the old nested ternary. `IsNestMethodStart` is the exact negation of the old skip condition. The loop bounds and the `k` skip-ahead are preserved. Nothing introduces an unused or unbuildable construct, though I reviewed the diff only and did not compile or run the tests.
